In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our system can be used to deliver high-quality IROI video streaming to a large population of viewers with limited uplink bandwidth at the server.
the proposed IROI video streaming system is a promising approach for the efficient delivery of interactive virtual pan/zoom video streams in P2P networks.
the proposed P2P multicast live video streaming scheme with interactive virtual pan-tilt-zoom functionality can be an effective solution for delivering live video to large populations of users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed and implemented an efficient and scalable P2P multicast live video streaming solution for IROI video streaming.

we have designed a scalable P2P system for interactive virtual pan/zoom video streaming that exploits the inherent redundancy of IROI video to provide high video quality with low server bandwidth consumption.
we have designed a novel peer-to-peer multicast video streaming system with IROI functionality and have demonstrated that it is scalable and efficient in terms of bandwidth usage.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the P2P overlay can be altered on-the-fly to adapt to the changing ROIs in a scalable manner.
